name: Luiz Carazolli
headline: Mathematician.
about: I’m a CAPES-funded master’s candidate in Mathematics at Unicamp, where I also earned my bachelor’s degree. My research connects algebraic geometry and symplectic topology, with a focus on orbifold Gromov–Witten theory and quantum cohomology. Alongside this work, I’m developing interests in topological data analysis and the mathematical foundations of deep learning, building on earlier applied AI research. I’m seeking an entry-level industry research role in mathematics, finance, or AI, and welcome connections across geometry, topology, and data science.
